properties.name: hidra.environment
properties.description: Current Hidra runtime environment name.

properties.name: hidra.application.name
properties.description: Displayed Hidra application name.

properties.name: hidra.application.description
properties.description: Displayed Hidra application description.

properties.name: hidra.application.base-package
properties.description: Canonical Java base package for HidraAPI.

properties.name: hidra.api.version
properties.description: Public API version label.

properties.name: hidra.api.base-path
properties.description: Public API base path.

properties.name: hidra.api.errors.include-debug-details
properties.description: Whether ProblemDetail responses include exception class details.

properties.name: hidra.api.errors.include-correlation-id
properties.description: Whether API errors include correlation identifiers.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.correlation.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header used for correlation identifiers.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.correlation.response-header-enabled
properties.description: Whether correlation identifiers are returned on responses.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.request.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header used for request identifiers.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.request.response-header-enabled
properties.description: Whether request identifiers are returned on responses.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.logging.structured
properties.description: Whether platform logs should include structured context fields.

properties.name: hidra.platform.observability.logging.mask-sensitive-values
properties.description: Whether sensitive logging values should be masked.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.enabled
properties.description: Whether HTTP security is enforced.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.cors.enabled
properties.description: Whether CORS support is enabled through Spring Security.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS HTTP methods.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS headers.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Comma-separated exposed CORS response headers.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.csrf.enabled
properties.description: Whether CSRF protection is enabled.

properties.name: hidra.security.bootstrap.username
properties.description: Bootstrap username used until external IAM/JWT integration is added.

properties.name: hidra.security.bootstrap.password
properties.description: Bootstrap password supplied through environment or secrets manager.

properties.name: hidra.security.bootstrap.roles
properties.description: Comma-separated bootstrap role names.

properties.name: hidra.platform.persistence.auditing.enabled
properties.description: Whether persistence auditing is expected to be active.

properties.name: hidra.platform.persistence.optimistic-locking.enabled
properties.description: Whether persistence optimistic locking is expected for mutable entities.

properties.name: hidra.platform.events.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Whether the platform outbox runtime processor is enabled.

properties.name: hidra.platform.events.outbox.table-name
properties.description: Platform outbox table name.

properties.name: hidra.platform.events.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum outbox events processed per batch.

properties.name: hidra.platform.events.outbox.max-retry-count
properties.description: Maximum outbox publication retries.

properties.name: hidra.platform.events.outbox.cleanup-enabled
properties.description: Whether published outbox cleanup is enabled.

properties.name: hidra.platform.tenancy.enabled
properties.description: Whether tenancy scoping is enabled.

properties.name: hidra.platform.tenancy.default-scope
properties.description: Default tenant or organization scope.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.authentication-mode
properties.description: Authentication mode: jwt, basic, or disabled.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.issuer-uri
properties.description: JWT issuer URI used for issuer discovery and validation.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: JWT JWK set URI used when issuer discovery is not available.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.hmac-secret
properties.description: Development-only HMAC secret for HS256 JWT validation.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.audience
properties.description: Expected JWT audience claim.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.principal-claim
properties.description: JWT claim used as the authenticated principal name.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.roles-claim
properties.description: JWT claim containing Hidra role authorities.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.scope-claim
properties.description: JWT claim containing OAuth2 scopes.

properties.name: hidra.platform.security.jwt.authority-prefix
properties.description: Authority prefix applied to JWT role claims.
